name: pgmoat
description: Governed, read-only Postgres access for Claude.
long_description: Ask Claude about your Postgres data with guardrails: read-only enforced in layers, hidden columns, row limits, tenant scoping, and a tamper-evident audit log. Runs on your machine.

database_url.label: Postgres connection URL
database_url.description: Use a read-only role. Example: postgresql://readonly@host:5432/db

config_path.label: pgmoat.yaml (optional)
config_path.description: Adds descriptions, hidden columns, RLS, and budgets

tools.name: describe_table
tools.title: Describe a table
tools.description: Show columns, types, primary keys, and relations for a visible table.

tools.name: explain
tools.title: Show a query plan
tools.description: Explain an execution plan without running write operations.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.title: List tables
tools.description: List all visible tables and views in allowed schemas.

tools.name: query
tools.title: Run a read-only SQL query
tools.description: Execute a validated read-only SQL query within row and timeout budgets.

tools.name: sample_table
tools.title: Show sample rows
tools.description: Sample up to budget limit rows from a visible table with sensitive masking.
